title: Focus the lesson report description on opening
steps: Open the lesson options drawer and click Report an Issue to inspect the blank description, placeholder, and character counter.
Type “The image is missing.” on the keyboard before clicking anywhere in the dialog and inspect the description and counter.
Click the description and type “The image is missing.” again; inspect the entered text and counter.

video_guide.summary: The first typing attempt leaves the lesson report description empty; typing after a click fills the field.

chapters.note: The open drawer includes Report an Issue.
The report dialog shows an empty description and a 0/2500 counter.
Icon-name text overlaps several issue-category labels, including spellcheck and broken_image.

chapters.label: Type The image is missing. without clicking inside the dialog.

chapters.note: The description still shows its placeholder and the counter reads 0/2500.

chapters.label: Click the description and type The image is missing. again.

chapters.note: The focused description contains The image is missing. and the counter reads 21/2500.
The open report dialog shows the entered description and a 21/2500 counter.
